correct_query: SELECT emp_name FROM staff WHERE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM assignments INNER JOIN offerings ON (assignments.item_id = offerings.item_id AND assignments.slot_id = offerings.slot_id AND assignments.term = offerings.term AND assignments.yr = offerings.yr) WHERE staff.emp_id = assignments.emp_id AND assignments.term = 'Spring')
